limitations: The exact formulas concern the displayed mixed-order phase reductions, not the full finite-coupling Stuart-Landau system to all orders. They address local full-synchrony stability only; omitted higher-order terms can move full-system thresholds, and broad priority for generic higher-order synchronization criteria is not claimed.
provenance: A source-specific synchronization-stability refinement of the mixed physical/emergent nonpairwise phase models in arXiv:2609.20632v1.
record_title: Exact synchrony interference law and stability-neutralizing coupling in three Stuart-Landau phases
